Source Hyderabad: After suffering their first defeat of the season, Sreenidi Deccan Football Club will look to bounce back when they take on Indian Football League (IFL) debutants FC Bengaluru United at the Bengaluru Football Stadium on Wednesday. 
 The Deccan Warriors suffered a narrow defeat 2-1 against Shillong Lajong FC in their previous IFL fixture, while FC Bengaluru United played out a 2-2 draw against Real Kashmir FC at home.
